name: eagle-sdd
description: Spec-driven development for coding agents: canonical specs, change deltas, and evidence-gated verification.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven development: spec, then implement, then verify against the spec
interface.longDescription: Guides a change through orient, grill, propose, specify, design, plan, implement, verify, and archive. Canonical specs live under docs/eagle-sdd/specs with changes stored as deltas, and verification is evidence-gated per requirement rather than per test run.
